content.intro: This lesson covers Database Access Libraries and Driver Concepts. It sits in Module 22, Databases and Backend Integration, and builds toward a practical Rust mental model rather than memorizing a term in isolation.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Database code must preserve data integrity across errors and concurrent requests. Bind values as parameters, use transactions for related changes, and plan schema migrations for compatibility.

content_blocks.title: A reliable way to reason about it
content_blocks.text: For Database Access Libraries and Driver Concepts, write down the inputs, the guarantee you expect, and the boundary where that guarantee stops. Work through a minimal example first; then deliberately test one edge case. Database-driver APIs are ecosystem-specific. Prefer bound parameters, explicit transaction scopes, migrations, and integration tests against a controlled database.
